title_zh: 真人感 / 去 AI 味（P0 叠加层）
status: speculative — not yet A/B-tested on a real video model; run docs/HUMAN_PREMIUM.md §8 Phase 0 A/B before treating as proven
status_zh: 推测性方案：还没有在真实视频模型上做 A/B；按 docs/HUMAN_PREMIUM.md §8 的 Phase 0 A/B 跑完之前，不要当成已验证
note: Overlay is applied at copy-time by `istream prompts overlay` and rendered into GENERATE_PACK.md. It never edits library.json, so `istream prompts verify` (K01–K03 byte identity) stays intact.

en: evenly lit, nothing else in frame
softly lit with a gentle natural falloff away from the key side, nothing else in frame
zh: 照明均匀，画面中没有其他物体
柔和受光，从主光一侧向外自然减光，画面中没有其他物体
replace.why_zh: 均匀平光的背景 = 空洞影棚，是 AI 味来源之一

replace.why: 'sharp face' invites over-sharpened skin; real portraits focus on the eyes
replace.why_zh: “脸部锐利”容易引出过度锐化的皮肤；真实人像对焦在眼睛

en: holds it still for one second
settles there for about one second, still breathing and blinking, never frozen
zh: 稳稳停留约一秒，仍在呼吸、眨眼，不是定格
replace.why: freeze-frame holds read as a mannequin; low motion is enough for a cut point
replace.why_zh: 定格式静止像人体模特；切点只需要“低运动”，不需要“零运动”

en: holds it still for two seconds
settles there for about two seconds, still breathing and blinking, never frozen
zh: 稳稳停留约两秒，仍在呼吸、眨眼，不是定格
replace.why: same, for the 60 s chain hold
replace.why_zh: 同上，用于 60 秒接力点

en: holds it still until the end
holds it calmly until the end, still breathing and blinking
zh: 安静地保持到结束（仍有呼吸和眨眼）

en: small, slow nods on stressed words
one or two small nods driven by the stressed words, never in a steady rhythm
zh: 在重音处缓慢地小幅点头
跟着重音偶尔小幅点头一两次，绝不按固定节拍
replace.why: metronomic nodding is the #1 motion tell
replace.why_zh: 节拍器式点头是最明显的动作 AI 痕迹

en: warm smile that starts in her eyes
zh: 露出先从眼睛里出来的温暖笑容
replace.why: 'bright' smiles show a wall of teeth (wax teeth); eye-led smiles read genuine
replace.why_zh: “明亮的笑”容易露出一整排牙（蜡像牙）；从眼睛开始的笑才像真的

en: easy, genuine smile that reaches her eyes
zh: 轻松、真实、笑到眼睛里的笑容

setting_append.en: Shot like a premium documentary interview on a cinema camera with an 85mm-equivalent portrait lens from a few metres away at about f/2.8: the eyes are critically sharp, the ears and the back of the hair fall off gently, and the wall behind her is softly out of focus. Key-to-fill ratio about 3:1, so the shadow side of the face keeps soft modelling, with one soft catchlight in each eye on the key side. Real skin: visible pores, fine vellus hair caught by the rim light, subtle unevenness of tone and a natural sheen on the high points, never glossy and never airbrushed. Restrained, natural film-like grade: true skin hue, soft highlight roll-off, gentle contrast; no beauty filter, no HDR look, no over-sharpening.
setting_append.zh: 按高端纪录片访谈的方式拍摄：电影摄影机，等效 85mm 人像镜头，从几米外拍，光圈约 f/2.8；眼睛焦点锐利，耳朵和脑后头发自然虚化，身后墙面柔和失焦。主光与补光约 3:1，脸部暗面保留柔和的立体感；双眼各有一个位于主光一侧的柔和眼神光。皮肤是真实的皮肤：可见毛孔、轮廓光下细小的绒毛、轻微不均匀的肤色，高光处是自然光泽，绝不油亮，绝不磨皮。克制自然的胶片感调色：肤色真实，高光过渡柔和，反差温和；不要美颜滤镜，不要 HDR 质感，不要过度锐化。

setting_compact.en: Premium documentary-interview look: 85mm-equivalent lens from a few metres at about f/2.8, eyes critically sharp, soft background falloff, key-to-fill about 3:1, one soft catchlight per eye; real skin with pores and fine vellus hair, natural sheen, never airbrushed; restrained natural grade, no beauty filter, no HDR, no over-sharpening.
setting_compact.zh: 高端纪录片访谈质感：等效 85mm、几米外、约 f/2.8，眼睛焦点锐利，背景柔和减光；主光与补光约 3:1，双眼各一个柔和眼神光；真实皮肤，可见毛孔和细绒毛，自然光泽，绝不磨皮；克制自然的调色，不要美颜、不要 HDR、不要过度锐化。

performance_append.en: Alive at rest: she is never frozen — her breathing shows softly in her chest and shoulders, she makes tiny weight shifts, and her eyes stay alive with small natural movements. Blinks are irregular (now and then a double blink, sometimes a longer gap), often at the end of a phrase or when her gaze shifts. Expressions are slightly asymmetric and driven by what she says: a brow lifts on a stressed word, a smile starts in the eyes and fades on its own. Between sentences her lips close fully and she takes a small breath. No movement repeats in a regular rhythm. Her hands stay exactly where described above, and nothing ever touches or covers the face.
performance_append.zh: 静止时也是活人：她从不定格——胸口和肩膀有柔和可见的呼吸起伏，身体有极轻微的重心移动，眼神有细小的自然转动。眨眼不规律（偶尔连眨两下，偶尔隔得久一点），多出现在一句话结尾或视线移动时。表情略带不对称，并跟着说话内容走：重音处眉毛微抬，笑意先出现在眼睛里，再自己慢慢退去。句与句之间双唇完全闭合，轻轻吸一口气。任何动作都不按固定节拍重复。双手的位置严格按上文描述，任何东西都不碰脸、不挡脸。

performance_compact.en: Alive at rest, never frozen: soft visible breathing, tiny weight shifts, irregular blinks, slightly asymmetric expressions driven by the words, lips fully closed between sentences; no movement repeats in a rhythm; hands stay as described and nothing touches the face.
performance_compact.zh: 静止时也是活人，从不定格：有柔和可见的呼吸、极轻微的重心移动、不规律的眨眼，表情略带不对称并跟着内容走，句间双唇完全闭合；任何动作不按节拍重复；双手按上文位置，任何东西不碰脸。

first_frame_append.en: Captured like an editorial portrait on a full-frame camera with an 85mm lens at f/2.8: natural skin with pores and fine vellus hair, a few fine flyaway hairs at the crown and along the parting, well away from the face, the subtle natural asymmetry of a real face, matte natural makeup, lips with natural texture, one soft catchlight in each eye, a relaxed and present expression. Not a beauty retouch, not a 3D render.
first_frame_append.zh: 像全画幅相机、85mm 镜头、f/2.8 拍下的杂志人像：真实皮肤，看得到毛孔和细小绒毛；头顶和发缝处有几根细碎发丝，远离脸部；保留真人脸自然的细微不对称；哑光自然妆；嘴唇有真实纹理；双眼各一个柔和眼神光；表情放松、在场。不是美颜精修，不是三维渲染。

style_line.en: Overall feel: a calm, premium interview — natural, intimate and quietly confident, like a carefully lit documentary, not an advertisement and not an avatar.
style_line.zh: 整体气质：沉静、高级的访谈感——自然、亲近、从容自信，像布光讲究的纪录片，而不是广告，也不是虚拟形象。

avoid_append.en: airbrushed or glossy skin, a frozen or constant smile, rhythmic nodding or blinking, mannequin-like stillness, helmet-like hair, an over-sharpened or HDR look
avoid_append.zh: 磨皮或油光皮肤，僵住或一直挂着的笑，机械节拍式点头或眨眼，人体模特式的定格，头盔式头发，过度锐化或 HDR 质感

scorecard.zh: 皮肤：100% 放大看鼻翼和脸颊，毛孔和细纹理清楚，而且帧与帧之间稳定（不磨皮，不“翻滚”）
scorecard.en: Skin: at 100% on nose/cheeks, pores and fine texture are visible and stable frame to frame (no airbrush, no boiling)

scorecard.zh: 眼睛：眨眼不规律（30 秒至少约 6 次、间隔不均），眼神有细小移动，眼神光和主光方向一致
scorecard.en: Eyes: irregular blinks (≈6+ per 30 s, uneven gaps), small eye movements, catchlight matches the key side

scorecard.zh: 呼吸：回位静止段肩膀和胸口有轻微起伏，不是定格画面
scorecard.en: Breathing: during home-pose holds the shoulders/chest move slightly — not a freeze-frame

scorecard.zh: 节奏：2 倍速看一遍，没有重复的点头或摇摆循环
scorecard.en: Rhythm: watched at 2×, no repeating nod or sway loop

scorecard.zh: 嘴：嘴唇有纹理，牙齿颗颗分明、不是一整块白，停顿时嘴完全闭合，没有糊嘴
scorecard.en: Mouth: textured lips, individually defined teeth (not a white block), full closure at pauses, no smear

scorecard.zh: 身份（一票否决）：0 / 10 / 20 / 30 秒四帧与参考图并排，是同一个人，无漂移
scorecard.en: Identity (veto): frames at 0/10/20/30 s side by side with the reference are the same person, no drift

scorecard.zh: 头发与边缘：头顶和发缝处有少量自然碎发（远离脸），发丝和耳朵边缘稳定不闪，不是头盔头
scorecard.en: Hair & edges: a few natural flyaways at the crown/parting (off the face), stable hair/ear edges, no helmet hair

scorecard.zh: 光与景深：脸的暗面有柔和立体感（不是平光），背景有减光和虚化，没有光晕或 HDR 感
scorecard.en: Light & depth: soft modelling on the shadow side (not flat), background falloff and defocus, no glow or HDR

scorecard.zh: 表情：笑容会出现也会自然退去，中性脸不呆，左右有细微不对称
scorecard.en: Expression: smiles arrive and fade, neutral face is not dead, slight left-right asymmetry

scorecard.zh: 底板纪律（一票否决）：手不过胸、不碰脸，切点处回位，嘴始终无遮挡，无字幕水印，曝光恒定
scorecard.en: Plate rules (veto): hands below chest and off the face, home pose at cut points, mouth never covered, no text/watermark, constant exposure

scorecard_rule.zh: 10 项里至少 9 个“是”才入库；第 6 项（身份）或第 10 项（底板纪律）任何一个“否”直接淘汰。
scorecard_rule.en: Enter the library only with ≥ 9 of 10 YES; a NO on #6 (identity) or #10 (plate rules) rejects the take regardless.
